metadata.proposed_air_note: User-requested island circuits are separate proposed campaign links, not catalog services. Magenta schematic air legs may cross land and water; no landing facilities, schedules or travel times inferred.
metadata.geometry: Sea-containing routes follow inferred paths through classified water; air-only routes remain schematic. Not surveyed shipping lanes.

routing.smoothing: Water-clear line-of-sight simplification followed by locally checked quadratic corners, up to 16 pixels.
routing.port_policy: Start/end at nearby connected water; do not draw land connectors or move catalog markers.
routing.blocked_policy: Omit legs without a connected water path; never fall back to straight lines.
routing.mask_limitations: Draft palette-classified source mask. Unknown pixels are blocked; narrow channels may be omitted. Mask correctness is not surveyed coastline accuracy.

metadata.missing_policy: Retain unresolved legs in data but do not draw them or bypass missing stops.
metadata.mixed_modes: Include routes containing sea or air; color by first mode, without inferring transfer locations.
